about: Pinned third-party sources for the CONTACT lab, fetched into .local/third_party (beside .local/sources; already skipped by the Vite watcher, the dependency scan and .gitignore). Reference code and ungated model data only: no binaries, no model weights, nothing here is executed by the fetch. Re-create with: .venv/bin/python scripts/setup_third_party.py
policy: Only permissively licensed sources (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD / CC0), licence checked by reading the LICENSE text or file headers on 2026-09-19. Non-commercial, GPL/AGPL and custom-licence projects are cited by URL in OPEN_SOURCE_STACK.md instead of being copied here, so restricted code cannot be pasted into the project by accident.

entries.name: sam2
entries.license: Apache-2.0; checkpoint is optional and is not fetched by setup_third_party.py
entries.purpose: Optional local SAM2.1 native-frame mask experiment. Runs float32 on MPS in a separate modern Python environment with SAM2_BUILD_CUDA=0. Dense hairline proposals remain experimental because sparse side fades can be lost; no production mask substitution. See docs/HEAD_MASK_EXPERIMENT.md.

entries.name: NFR_pytorch
entries.license: MIT (code); pretrained assets are not fetched
entries.purpose: Reference for local deformation Jacobians and area-weighted global mesh reconstruction. Browser adaptation in src/deformation-gradient.js; CUDA inference/training is not installed or used.

entries.name: ICT-FaceKit
entries.purpose: Ungated full-head morphable template: 26,719 verts incl. ears/neck/scalp, teeth, eyeballs; 100 identity modes; 53 ARKit-named expression shapes that line up with MediaPipe's 52 blendshape scores. Replaces the 468-point landmark mesh, the gray estimated cranium and the 4 heuristic morphs.

entries.name: GNM
entries.purpose: Google GNM Head (2026): stronger ungated identity prior (17,821 verts, built from ~5,000 subjects) if ICT-FaceKit's identity space proves too generic. numpy/torch backends; needs Python >= 3.10.

entries.name: gnm-webcam-puppet
entries.purpose: Browser runtime for GNM plus webcam_puppet/assets/correspondence.npz: 473 MediaPipe-landmark -> GNM-vertex pairs with rigid-point flags. Load the .npz with allow_pickle=False.

entries.name: spark
entries.purpose: Source, docs and the interactive-deform example for the Spark 2.2.0 renderer already in node_modules (which ships dist only). Read src/SplatSkinning.ts::applyCovSplatLBSkinning and src/SplatMesh.ts for the covariance-splat path that lets splats rotate/stretch/shear with the mesh.

entries.name: map-anything
entries.license: Apache-2.0 (code). Weights: facebook/map-anything-apache is Apache-2.0; facebook/map-anything is CC-BY-NC-4.0
entries.purpose: Feed-forward multi-view poses + dense depth with merged MPS support; accepts KNOWN intrinsics. scripts/demo_inference_on_colmap_outputs.py turns an existing COLMAP solve into per-view depth for TSDF fusion.

entries.name: Depth-Anything-3
entries.license: Apache-2.0 (code). Weights split: BASE/SMALL/METRIC-LARGE Apache-2.0; GIANT-1.1 and NESTED CC-BY-NC-4.0; LARGE-1.1 disputed
entries.purpose: Pose-conditioned multi-view depth that lands in the COLMAP frame and scale (`da3 colmap ... --device mps`), i.e. a dense-geometry source the pipeline currently lacks.

entries.name: MoGe
entries.license: MIT (LICENSE file also carries an Apache-2.0 section)
entries.purpose: MoGe-2 metric depth + normals per view, accepts a known fov_x. PINNED to a pre-v3 commit on purpose: main is v3, whose README says macOS is not supported.

entries.name: Hierarchical-Localization
entries.purpose: hloc: learned features/matching (ALIKED + LightGlue) written into a COLMAP database. Works with the project's current pycolmap 3.13. Submodules are deliberately NOT fetched (SuperGlue/SuperPoint carry restrictive licences; use the aliked configs).

entries.name: LightGlue
entries.purpose: Matcher used by hloc. Use the ALIKED or DISK extractors; avoid SuperPoint weights (Magic Leap licence).

entries.name: anny
entries.license: Apache-2.0 code; bundled MakeHuman/MPFB2 and Face Units data CC0-1.0
entries.purpose: Ungated, rigged full-body template (104 bones incl. fingers) to fit a personal arm + hand without MANO/SMPL-X. Stay on topology="anny": the optional smplx topology downloads NON-COMMERCIAL assets.

entries.name: MHR
entries.purpose: Meta Momentum Human Rig: alternative ungated body/hand rig with LODs and pose correctives.

entries.name: face-parsing
entries.license: MIT code. Released ONNX weights are trained on CelebAMask-HQ (non-commercial research terms)
entries.purpose: BiSeNet 19-class face parsing incl. eyeglasses, hair, ears, brows, lips, neck. Mask glasses/hair out of SfM and training; project labels onto the mesh for a per-region stiffness table.

entries.name: JoltPhysics.js
entries.purpose: Maintained WASM engine fallback: XPBD soft bodies with tet volume constraints, kinematic-collider contact with friction, and skinned constraints with back-stop (a ready-made skull/support layer). No self-collision.

entries.name: single-files/ten-minute-physics
entries.license: MIT, stated in each file's own header (the repo has no LICENSE file). Only files carrying that header were taken
entries.purpose: Reference XPBD tetrahedral soft body (demo 10) and tet-cage -> visual-mesh barycentric skinning (demo 12: computeSkinningInfo / updateVisMesh). Basis for an in-browser Web Worker solver replacing the Newton HTTP loop. The repo is 473 MB, so only these files were taken.

entries.name: single-files/dn-splatter
entries.purpose: Permissively licensed reference for meshing from RENDERED depth/normal maps (DepthAndNormalMapsPoisson, TSDF variants) instead of from Gaussian centres.

entries.name: single-files/QtMeshEditor
entries.purpose: Worked example: parse ICT-FaceKit OBJs by hand (trimesh reorders vertices on these files), wrap the template with trimesh NRICP, transfer blendshapes.
